_comment: Data-driven case lifecycle. The server rejects any transition not listed here. actor = persona (CSR / DRI) or agent / system id. The process ends at the DRI's decision (APPROVED or REJECTED), which seals the case. NO_ISSUE ends a CSR account lookup where no rule fired (no case is opened).
